title: The verifier's tally beside an author panel (definition version 6, ballot version 4, tally-opening version 3, destruction statement version 2): definitions, clocks, boards carrying both panels' transcripts, the author approvals, ballots, share receipts, partial openings and destruction statements, and the pinned default panel, with the rows 5.9, 6.3, 7.1 to 7.4 and 8.5, the counted ballots' entries and the report's cells, tiers, tallies and destruction
generator: packages/crypto/scripts/verifier-tally-v3-author-vectors.py, from verifier-ballots-v4-author-vectors.py, ballot-v4-vectors.py, tally-vectors.py, panel-tally-vectors.py, verifier-ceremony-vectors.py, ceremony-vectors.py, delivery-vectors.py, delivery-v2-vectors.py, intake-v4-vectors.py and verifier-openings-vectors.py (independent Python implementations); membership proofs by packages/crypto/scripts/ballot-proofs.mjs, run outside the workspace with Semaphore 4.14.3's depth-32 circuit artifacts and snarkjs 0.7.5

cases.description: Every registered seat of both panels receipts each ballot, so each cell counts its one ballot. Author seat 1's partial opening of every cell is boarded at the floor of s_S plus one, then default seat 2's; default seat 3's partial opening of cell 1 matches seat 2's, an author partial opening of cell 0 signed with default seat 1's key is unattributed and still counts, an opening naming panel 3 is stray and a version-1 header is a rejected entry. Every cell passes, its count the sum of both panels' partial openings, and each tier's counts are its cells' sums.
No author partial opening of cell 1: it fails tally-missing for the author panel, checked first, though default seat 2 opened its half; cells 0 and 2 pass.

No author partial opening of cell 2 at all, and no default partial opening of cell 0: some cell's author opening is late whatever s_A is, so cell 0, the first failing cell, fails tally-author-late, the author panel's or the operator's, never the default panel's; cell 2 fails tally-missing for the author panel.

Every cell's author partial opening is on the board, but cell 2's only in segment 242, past s_A's floor 222, and cell 0 has no default partial opening: cell 0 is tally-author-late if s_A is below 242 and the default panel's tally-missing otherwise, and only s_S, which this bundle doesn't fix, decides which; cell 0 and 7.2 are undecided, never a code that may name the wrong panel.

As author-late-undecided, but cell 2's author partial opening is boarded in segment 222, s_A's floor: in time whatever s_S is, so cell 0's missing default partial opening is the default panel's tally-missing (the default panel's or the operator's).
As author-at-floor, but cell 2's author partial opening is boarded in segment 223, one above s_A's floor: late if s_S is at its floor and in time otherwise, so cell 0 and 7.2 are undecided.
Every author partial opening is timely, at or below s_A's floor, and cell 1 has no default partial opening: it fails tally-missing for the default panel (the default panel's or the operator's).
Default seat 2's partial opening of cell 0 is off by one at option 0 and is the cell's only default one: it fails tally-opening for the default panel at option 0, whatever the author did.

Author seat 2 never receipts the cell-1 ballot, so delivery excludes it and cell 1 counts nothing, while both panels' partial openings of cell 1 are over that ballot: neither panel's aggregate hash is cell 1's over its counted set, so it fails tally-opening for the author panel, checked first, with no option; cells 0 and 2 pass.

Default seat 2's partial opening of cell 0 is boarded before any author one (tally-early, the operator's, and it still counts); author seat 1's partial opening of cell 1 is boarded twice, byte for byte (tally-repeat, the operator's alone), and its second of cell 2 is over an empty set (tally-aggregate, and tally-second: evidence against the seat); author seat 2's partial opening of cell 0 is no second of default seat 2's, whose index it shares, since each is attributed by its own panel's key set. Every cell passes; 7.4 fails at the first break, tally-early.

As counted without the strays, and every registered seat of both panels states destruction (version 2) in segment 126, once every cell has both panels' partial openings: each is destroyed, and 8.5 passes.

Default seat 1 states destruction in segment 126 (destroyed) and default seat 2 in segment 124, before the last cell's default partial opening (destruction-early, the seat's); author seat 1 twice (the second a duplicate); a statement for author seat 2 signed with default seat 2's key and one for default seat 2 signed with author seat 2's (each unattributed: a statement is attributed only by the key set of the panel it names); default seat 3's for another definition (stray, attributed to it) and a version-1 statement (rejected). Default seat 3 and author seat 2 are destruction-missing; 8.5 fails at the first seat that isn't destroyed, default seat 2.

As author-missing (cell 1 never has an author partial opening, so the destruction segment is s_T, known only from below, at least 294): default seat 1's statement in segment 126 is early whatever s_T is, and every other seat's in segment 294 is undecided, since s_T may lie above it; 8.5 is unverifiable at the first undecided seat, default seat 2.
